_comment: Hindi templates. {0},{1},... are protected values captured from the English response and re-inserted verbatim - report names, dates, times, numbers, acronyms. The slot COUNT must match en.json exactly or the entry is refused at runtime and the text falls through to the translation model. Numbers stay in Western Arabic digits because the pipeline and the .NET API parse them back.
